async.note: Polling counts against Agent API QPS (Tier 0 = 1 QPS).

cost_model: Tokens of the effort's model (high = openai/gpt-6.1-terra) + tool calls: web_search fast $0.001 (presets default to Fast Search), fetch_url $0.0005. Up to 40 steps. Response usage.total_cost is authoritative.

docs.supports: Sonar Chat Completions support ended 2026-09-27; model->effort mapping
param mapping: search_context_size -> max_tokens, filters move into web_search tool
effort table: high = gpt-6.1-terra, 40 steps, web_search+fetch_url
web_search filters, max_tokens, presets default to fast search
Sep-Nov effort changes, preset->effort rename, ultra

query_transform_notes: Sonar migration guide: sonar-deep-research -> effort 'high'. Effort page: high = 'deep, source-heavy research without code execution, where completeness matters more than latency'.

rationale.effort: Vendor's own recommendation for deep research without code. 'xhigh' (Claude Opus 5.5, 300 steps, sandbox) and 'ultra' (broad coverage) are pre-registered variants; xhigh/ultra run on Anthropic models, which confounds a vendor comparison.

background.note: Background mode is documented for long runs (ultra) and Sonar async migration; not explicitly for 'high'.

est_cost_usd_per_question.note: No per-effort price published; gpt-6.1-terra token price not read. Estimate.

freshness_overlay.note: Supplying a tools array alongside effort: docs only state that search_type on web_search overrides the preset; whether a filters-only tool entry merges with the preset's tool config is not documented.
